full_name: Rebecca Dirksen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Rebecca Dirksen is an assistant professor in the Department of Folklore and Ethnomusicology at Indiana University (IU). Working across the spectrum of musical genres in Haiti and its diaspora, her research concerns cultural approaches to development, creative responses to crisis and disaster, dialogues of sustainability and diverse environmentalisms, intangible cultural heritage and cultural policy, and applied/engaged scholarship.
